record_identity.identity: selected index plus resolved record pointer
record_identity.reacquire_requirement: reacquire the same selected index and record identity before write and postverify

likes.scan: scan all four physical Like slots; -1 is not an early terminator

dislikes.scan: scan all four physical Dislike slots; -1 is not an early terminator

eligibility_gate.selected_villager: selected index is in 0..255 and resolves to the displayed record
eligibility_gate.status_or_faction: no additional VV1 status or faction discriminator is claimed

vv5_faction_gate.required_if_vv5: record+0x1CEC == 0 before any preference read or count

transaction_contract.dry_run: complete dry-run reads all four Likes and all four Dislikes before confirmation; it performs no writes and no charge
transaction_contract.already_running: any Running Like is a whole-record zero-write/no-charge skip; preserve duplicate Running Likes and every Dislike
transaction_contract.destination: otherwise prove the first physical -1 Like slot before any Dislike write
transaction_contract.full_likes: no empty Like slot is a zero-write/no-charge result and leaves all Dislikes unchanged
transaction_contract.commit_writes: after destination proof, write Running ID 38 once to the first physical -1 Like and clear every Running Dislike to -1; preserve unrelated slots and ordering
transaction_contract.dislike_order: every Running Dislike is cleared only after a destination Like is proven
transaction_contract.confirmation: confirm Grant Running for 40,000 tech points only after the dry-run and funds check
transaction_contract.reacquire: reacquire the selected index and record identity, eligibility, and the complete eight-slot snapshot before mutation
transaction_contract.postverify: postverify the complete eight-slot result and funds immediately before the deduction
transaction_contract.one_charge: one-charge phase: deduct exactly 40,000 tech points once, only after successful postverify
transaction_contract.no_deduction_text: No tech points have been deducted.
transaction_contract.rollback_limit: No complete rollback is claimed: without a proven native preference-write ABI and stable reacquire ABI, a failed write/readback must make no charge and disclose any retained per-slot effects rather than claiming restoration

preference_write.existing_path: current VV1 detail source uses direct DWORD stores and scans only three slots
preference_write.native_preference_write_api: not proven in the exact-build evidence
preference_write.native_readback_api: not proven in the exact-build evidence

tech_account.native_spending_or_deduction_api: not proven in the exact-build evidence

selected_villager.known_path: detail handler reads state+0xAD34 and computes [detail_context+0x10] + index * 0x3D8

evidence.audit_notes: Cross-game preference-matrix evidence fixes VV1 at four Like plus four Dislike DWORDs; the existing VV1 helper is not a complete implementation of that contract.
